characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Random Movement (3D6") and its Attack Value is set to 4D3. It loses Harnessed and the Pitmaster model part, and its base size is changed to 60×100 SI.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength. The wielder gains Parry while using this weapon .

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Bodyguard (General) and Great Weapon, and loses Halberd.The model does not count towards the army's model cap of max. 120 Blackfur Veterans.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Standard Bearer and Eagle Standard, with the following exceptions:
  •
  • The model may take up to two Banner Enchantments.
  • While the model’s unit is in Line Formation, the model's unit may reroll natural to-wound rolls of ‘1’ with its Close Combat Attacks.
  • When calculating Combat Score, only a single model with Greater Eagle Standard per unit adds +1 to its side's Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 12", Shots D6+1, Strength D6+1, Armour Penetration 3, Reload!, Mishap (Roll for number of Shots), March and Shoot. The attacks hit automatically.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

The model's Grind Attacks are resolved with Strength D6+1 and Armour Penetration 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Units consisting entirely of models with Unstable Engines:
  • Gain +D6" to their Charge Range rolls in the Charge Phase. Also add this D6 to the Failed Charge distance.
  • Immediately after choosing to perform a March Move, gain +D6" March Rate.
The effects last until the end of the phase.
Immediately before a model is removed as a casualty from the unit, the model inflicts D6 hits with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 0 and Flaming Attacks on all other units within 6" of the model's unit. These hits are considered Special Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

While the model's unit is in base contact with one or more enemy Characters, the model gains +1 Attack Value for each other Duskblade Assassin in the same unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model cannot be chosen by the opponent as the model that suffers the penalties for refusing a Duel.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Flaming Attacks and Flammable, and its base size is changed to 25×50 SI. Immediately before the model is removed as a casualty as a result of any enemy Melee Attack, it inflicts 1 hit with Str 3, AP 0, and Flaming Attacks on the attacking unit. This is considered a Special Attack.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

For each model with Fetthis Fleshmaster within 12", units consisting entirely of Arena Beasts, Fetthis Brutes, Giant Rats, and models on Praetorian Brute or Triumphal Platform gain one instance of Maximised (Charge Range) in the Charge Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

At the beginning of each friendly Magic Phase, each Stygian Overseer may move a single friendly Tunnel Marker within 24" that is not in contact with any unit. Move this marker in a straight line up to 6", stopping immediately before moving into contact with any units. Each Tunnel Marker may only be moved once per Magic Phase. In addition, each Stygian Overseer on the Army List increases the duplication limit of Legionary Drill Teams by 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Engineer (3+) with the following exceptions:
  • It can also be used on Shooting and Artillery Weapons with Mishap (X).
  • All models in a single friendly unit within 6" benefit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

At the start of any Melee Phase, the model may choose to inflict D3 hits on its unit that wound automatically with Armour Penetration 10. If so, Standard Height R&F models in the model's unit gain Lightning Reflexes until the end of the Melee Phase. Note that these Health Point losses do not count towards Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 8", Shots 2, Str 6, AP 2, Accurate, Flaming Attacks, Quick to Fire, Volley Fire. When shooting at an enemy unit Engaged in Combat, hits are distributed onto a randomly chosen friendly unit Engaged with the original target on a roll of 5+ instead of 4+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

One use only. May be activated at the end of any friendly Movement Phase if all of the following conditions are met:
  • The model’s unit consists entirely of Standard Height Infantry models.
  • The model's unit is neither Engaged nor Shaken.
  • One or more models in the model's unit are touching a friendly Tunnel Marker.
Apply the following rules:
  • The model’s unit loses Scoring until the start of the next Player Turn.
  • Remove the model’s unit from the Battlefield.
  • Immediately place it back on the Battlefield with Special Ambush (within 1.5” of a friendly Tunnel Marker). If the unit cannot be placed, it is considered destroyed where it was removed.
  • The unit suffers D6 hits that wound automatically with no saves of any kind allowed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

While the model's unit is Steadfast and does not suffer from Disrupted Ranks, it gains Unbreakable.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Halberd. The wielder gains Devastating Charge (Lethal Strike). In addition, the wielder and enemy units in base contact with one or more models using a Plague Flail suffer -1 Defensive Skill.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model must be the General. While within range of the model's Commanding Presence, other friendly units that do not contain any models with Cult of Errahman gain Unstable while Steadfast and not suffering from Disrupted Ranks.For the purpose of Holy Triumvirate, the model counts as having Caelysian Pantheon.

characteristics.name: Rule

Universal Rule

The model gains Lightning Reflexes and adds +2 to its side's Combat Score in combats which it is Engaged in when Combat Scores are calculated.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Multiple Wounds (D3, Clipped Wings) and Swiftstride.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Fortitude (4+) and Hard Target (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Exclusive (Plague Disciples, Vermin Slaves) and ignores the Insignificant and Exclusive (Cult of Errahman) rules for the purpose of joining Vermin Slaves units. In addition, the number of its Impact Hits is increased by D3.
The model's unit gains Fearless and Poison Attacks. If the models already had Poison Attacks, they wound automatically on a successful natural to-hit roll of ‘5’ or ‘6’, unless the target has Immune (Poison Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Deafening Clamour, Exclusive (Blackfur Veterans, Vermin Legionaries), and the model's unit gains Fearless. In addition, the range of non-Bound Spells cast by the model is increased by 3".

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Commanding Presence (+6", max. 18"). In addition, the model gains +1 Discipline, up to a maximum of 7, while within 12" of one or more enemy models.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The unit may start the game in Tunnel Reserve. Ambush rolls of units consisting entirely of models with Sicarran Smugglers may be rerolled. This overrides the restriction of rules and abilities not working while the model is off the board.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model may choose to start the game in Tunnel Reserve. Once per game, at the end of the owner's Movement Phase, the model's unit may be removed from the Battlefield and placed in the Tunnel Reserve. This cannot be done if the model is Engaged or Shaken. Unless there are 4 friendly Tunnel Markers on the Battlefield, you may mark a point on the Battlefield with a Tunnel Marker that the model touched when it was removed.

Universal Rule

At the start of any phase, the owner can choose to remove the model as a casualty. When the model is removed as a casualty, all units within 6" suffer 2D6 hits with Strength 4 and Armour Penetration 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Multiple Wounds (2, against Large, Gigantic) and Paired Weapons. In addition, while within 6" of any other Large or Gigantic unit or any Terrain Feature other than Open Terrain, the model gains Hard Target (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
While a non-Fleeing unit with one or more Eagle Standards is within range of a friendly non-Fleeing model's Commanding Presence, the unit gains Rally Around the Flag (8", max. 8").
While within range of one or more instances of Rally Around the Flag from a friendly Eagle Standard, units gain Minimised (Discipline Tests) .
The ancient Avrasi used an eagle to represent their legions: a sacred totem that they would follow into the jaws of death. The Vermin have adopted this practice, finding uncharacteristic courage in defence of a symbol that transcends their short lives. In their enthusiasm, most Vermin legions take multiple eagles, and some are very crude creations, from simple sculptures to wooden triangles.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Health Point losses of the model that are caused by friendly models are ignored for Panic (including units destroyed due to attacks from friendly models). The model may use Shooting Attacks against enemy units Engaged in Combat, with the following rules and restrictions:
  • Friendly units Engaged in this Combat are ignored for Cover purposes (but not for drawing Line of Sight).
  • Roll to hit as normal against the intended target. Immediately after determining the number of hits, roll a D6 for each hit. On a roll of 4+, the hit is distributed onto a randomly chosen friendly unit Engaged with the original target. Otherwise, proceed as normal.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When calculating Combat Score, halve the first 10 Health Point losses of models with Life is Cheap per unit, rounding fractions up. This does not affect Combat Score bonuses from Overkill.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--3 Models/Army.
The model knows The Endless Swarm (Hereditary Spell) in addition to its other spells. If there are at least 3 models with Holy Triumvirate on your Army List, and they all have either Caelysian Pantheon or they all have Cult of Errahman, each of these models can select spells as follows:
  • Wizard Apprentices: select from the Learned Spells 1, 2, 3, and 4 of their chosen Path.
  • Wizard Adepts: select from the Learned Spells 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 of their chosen Path.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While the model's unit is Steadfast and does not suffer from Disrupted Ranks, the model gains two instances of Fight in Extra Rank. Check if the conditions are met and apply the effects at the start of each Initiative Step.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Immediately before performing a Shooting Attack with the weapon, the owner may choose to use the Trial and Terror shooting mode. If one model uses the Trial and Terror shooting mode, then all models in its unit must use it. If so, the Shooting Attack gains +1 to wound. The effects last until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model suffers a Mishap when it rolls a natural ‘1’ for the type of roll described in brackets (X). If X is Misfire, the model suffers a Mishap instead of suffering effects from Misfire.
A roll resulting in a Mishap can never be rerolled and an attack resulting in a Mishap is always lost.
When suffering a Mishap, after all simultaneous Shooting Attacks or Close Combat Attacks have been resolved, the model suffers 1 hit that wounds automatically with Armour Penetration 10.
If the Trial and Terror shooting mode was used, the model suffers 1 hit and its unit suffers 2 additional hits that all wound automatically with Armour Penetration 10 instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Exclusive (Cult of Errahman), and Characters with Cult of Errahman and their units gain Swiftstride. In addition, whenever a natural ‘1’ is rolled to hit for an enemy Close Combat Attack allocated towards a model with Cult of Errahman, the model part inflicts 1 hit with Toxic Attacks on the attacking model's unit in the same Initiative Step, before any casualties are removed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Paired Weapons. Attacks made with Bloodpox Blades become Poison Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--9 Models/Army.

Range 18", Shots 1, Area Attack (1×3), Mishap (To-hit roll), Toxic Attacks, Trial and Terror, Volley Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--6 Models/Army.

Flamethrower. Range 18", Shots 1, Str 2, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Mishap (Misfire), Trial and Terror. The model gains Flammable. The total number of simultaneous hits from a unit with this weapon cannot exceed the number of models in the target unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--12 Models/Army.

Range 18", Shots D6, Str 4, AP 2, Mishap (Roll for number of Shots), Trial and Terror.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--18 Models/Army.

Range 30", Shots 1, Str 5, AP 3, Accurate, Mishap (To-hit roll), Unwieldy, Trial and Terror.
The model part gains Aegis (4+) that can only be used against wounds from Mishaps.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains +1 Discipline Value. In addition, during Army List creation, it must choose one Artefact from this Army Book or the Arcane Compendium, whose Point Cost is added to the model's Point Cost.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Hatred. When friendly units within its range of Commanding Presence lose Health Points due to Unstable, the number of lost Health Points is reduced by the unit’s number of Full Ranks, up to a maximum of 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model knows The Endless Swarm (Hereditary Spell) in addition to its other spells. In addition, the model may choose Divination as its Path of Magic and it always selects its spells from all Learned Spells of its chosen Path.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model may not use its Shooting Weapon if the model performed a March Move in this Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model can only perform its Grind Attacks against units Engaged with its Front Facing. The model gains +3 Armour against:
  • Shooting Attacks from enemy models Located in the model's Front Arc.
  • Melee Attacks from units Engaged with the model's Front Facing.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Each Vermin Swarm army gains two Tunnel Markers and can gain additional Tunnel Markers by including certain units in the Army List. At the start of step 7 of the Pre-Game Sequence (Spell Selection), for each of your army's Tunnel Markers, mark a point inside your half of the Battlefield with a Tunnel Marker. There can only be up to 4 friendly Tunnel Markers on the Battlefield at any time.
Having dwelt almost exclusively underground for centuries, the Vermin are expert diggers, often able to tunnel under a battlefield in advance or even during an engagement. This sometimes allows them to emerge in the midst of battle, to the enemy’s great surprise.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Certain units have the ability to either enter or start the game in Tunnel Reserve. These units gain Special Ambush (within 1.5" of a friendly Tunnel Marker).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The range of this spell can be measured from the Caster or from the centre of any friendly Tunnel Marker on the Battlefield. The target's number of Health Point losses that count towards Life is Cheap is increased by 4.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using this weapon, the wielder gains Grind Attacks (X), where X is the number of Full Ranks in the wielder's unit, up to a maximum of 10. These Grind Attacks are resolved with Strength 3 and Armour Penetration 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The weapon's range is set to 18". The weapon gains +2 Shots, +1 Armour Penetration, and Accurate.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attacks made with this weapon are subject to the following rules:


  • They become Divine Attacks.

  • They gain Mishap (roll to wound) and Multiple Wounds (D3, Clipped Wings).

  • They wound on 2+.

  • Their Armour Penetration is always set to 3.


In addition, while using this weapon, the wielder's Attack Value is set to 6 and, unless another model does so first, the wielder must accept or issue a Duel.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Aim 2+. Range is set to 24". The weapon gains Flaming Attacks, Volley Fire, and Mishap (To-hit roll). If the weapon hits, it causes D6 hits whose Strength is set to 5 and whose Armour Penetration is set to 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit may start the game in Tunnel Reserve. If the bearer is on the Battlefield, the owner may choose to roll for Ambush of units in Tunnel Reserve starting from the owner’s Player Turn 1 (but still at the end of step 2 of the Movement Phase Sequence), unless the owner has the first Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer and R&F models in the bearer's unit gain Battle Focus. Additionally, for each natural to-hit roll of ‘1’ with a Close Combat Attack made by the bearer's unit, the bearer's unit suffers 1 hit with Strength 3 and Armour Penetration 0 in the same Initiative Step. This is considered a Special Attack.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Health Point, Cult of Errahman, and Fortitude (4+), but automatically fails all Armour Saves and looses Caelysian Pantheon if it had it. In addition, natural to-hit rolls of ‘6’ with Close Combat Attacks against the wearer must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Stand Behind and cannot issue Duels.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the bearer has Holy Triumvirate, its Path access is replaced with Occultism, Thaumaturgy, and Witchcraft.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
For all non-Attribute Spells cast by the bearer:



  • that don't have an Attribute Spell, Guiding Light (Divination) becomes the Attribute Spell.

  • that do have an Attribute Spell, Guiding Light (Divination) replaces the spell's Attribute Spell.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Immediately after Siphon the Veil, the bearer may choose to inflict 3 hits on its unit that wound automatically with no saves of any kind allowed. If so, the owner gains 3 additional Veil Tokens.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Whenever a friendly model in a unit within 8" of the bearer suffers a Mishap for a Shooting Attack, the number of the Mishap's hits is reduced by 1 and the bearer gains a counter until the end of the phase. At the end of each phase in which the bearer gained at least 1 counter, roll 2D6 and add the number of counters. If the result is 13 or higher, the bearer's unit suffers D6 hits with Strength 4 and Armour Penetration 1 and the Artefact is ignored for the rest of the game.
